name: cpdf
description: Professional PDF manipulation tool for merging, splitting, encrypting, and advanced document operations

cpdf.description: Professional PDF manipulation tool with comprehensive document processing and security features
cpdf.usage:
cpdf file1.pdf file2.pdf -o merged.pdf # Merge multiple PDF files
cpdf input.pdf 1-5 -o pages1to5.pdf # Extract pages 1-5
cpdf input.pdf even -o even_pages.pdf # Extract even pages only
cpdf input.pdf -encrypt 40bit owner user -o encrypted.pdf # Encrypt PDF with passwords
cpdf input.pdf -decrypt user -o decrypted.pdf # Decrypt PDF with user password
cpdf input.pdf -add-text "CONFIDENTIAL" -o watermarked.pdf # Add text watermark
cpdf input.pdf -rotate-contents 90 -o rotated.pdf # Rotate page contents 90 degrees
cpdf input.pdf -scale-page "0.8 0.8" -o scaled.pdf # Scale pages to 80%
cpdf input.pdf -list-bookmarks # List all PDF bookmarks
cpdf input.pdf -crop "72 72 72 72" -o cropped.pdf # Crop pages with margins
